abstention_policy.confidence_definition: max calibrated probability for logistic; normalized distance margin for centroid; margin-to-probability calibration fit on calibration only if needed
abstention_policy.not_allowed: no threshold tuning on heldout, 31/41 diagnostic rows, near-orphan, fold-conflict, local-tail, or OOS router controls
abstention_policy.threshold_selection: calibration only; sweep confidence thresholds and choose the highest-coverage threshold satisfying calibration risk <= 0.20 and calibration OOS false-positive rate <= 0.05. If no threshold satisfies both, use abstain-all.

dataset_contract.calibration_rows: metadata.split_assignment == in_distribution_train_cal_candidate and proposed_train_cal_split == calibration from feasibility artifact
dataset_contract.evaluation_only_rows: all 31+10 diagnostic rows; never train/calibrate or tune threshold
excluded_rows: all secondary OOD probe rows from train/calibration
dataset_contract.train_rows: metadata.split_assignment == in_distribution_train_cal_candidate and proposed_train_cal_split == train from feasibility artifact

non_claims: not a claim learned reps beat Foldseek/geometry

feature_vectorization_contract.flattening: deterministically flatten numeric, boolean, categorical count, node, edge, cofactor/pocket features from predictive_features
feature_vectorization_contract.metadata_allowed_only_for: row id, split assignment, target extraction, diagnostic grouping after predictions
feature_vectorization_contract.missing_features: zero after train-fitted feature union; report feature sparsity
feature_vectorization_contract.scaling: fit z-score scaler on train rows only; apply to calibration and diagnostic rows

model_choices_for_tiny_smoke.configuration: multinomial logistic regression, L2 regularization, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=2000, deterministic seed 20260528
train-set class centroids in z-scored feature space; confidence from negative distance margin
model_choices_for_tiny_smoke.purpose: nonparametric sanity baseline on same vectors

model_choices_for_tiny_smoke.configuration: closed-form ridge one-vs-rest on train matrix using numpy; calibration from margins

next_recommended_automation.task: Implement the run script and unit tests using toy data only; do not run it on real train/cal cache without user approval.

risk_assessment.main_risk: The smoke may mostly rediscover the hand-built geometry features already known to work, so success is not automatically novel.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Compare only within the diagnostic report against Wave 1.1 geometry/Foldseek cells; treat the result as a routing/feature feasibility test, not a claim.
risk_assessment.overfit_risk: Moderate because train/cal comes from M-CSA and broad parent labels; controlled by heldout diagnostic cells and no threshold tuning outside calibration.
risk_assessment.value_if_negative: A negative or abstain-heavy result would justify focusing on external panels, v2 labels, and geometry/Foldseek engine rather than neural scaling.

stop_conditions: Any heldout or review_only_not_training row is selected for train/calibration.
Any forbidden metadata key appears under predictive_features or flattened feature names.
m_csa:497 or m_csa:750 appears in train/calibration.
Calibration threshold is selected using any diagnostic/heldout cell.
OOS false-positive rate on calibration cannot meet the predeclared gate without abstaining on all rows.
The run attempts to write labels, registries, thresholds, production scoring, imports, or ontology files.

target_extraction_policy.class_balance: use class_weight=balanced or inverse-frequency loss to prevent OOS dominance
target_extraction_policy.secondary_targets: cobalamin_radical_rearrangement and flavin_monooxygenase are canary-only, not trained classes
target_extraction_policy.target_source: metadata.current_fingerprint_id, mapping null/None to explicit OOS target None; used only as target, never predictive feature

why_this_smoke_is_still_useful: Wave 1.1 showed learned representations are not decision-grade against Foldseek/geometry on current broad labels, but it did not test a feature set restricted to active-site geometry/cofactor/pocket descriptors.

The new 547-row cache gives an in-distribution train/cal pool that clears leakage preflight; this lets a tiny supervised smoke ask whether active-site-local features learn anything beyond the hand-built geometry scorer.

The 41-row diagnostic cache contains near-orphan, fold-conflict, OOS, external-priority, and local-tail stress rows that can be held out entirely from training and used only for qualitative diagnostics.
A negative result is valuable: if this active-site feature smoke fails, it argues for external label acquisition and geometry/Foldseek routing before spending compute on larger neural models.
